evals.prompt: we keep re-explaining this repo to claude every session and it still runs the wrong test command (it guesses pytest, but our suite is `python -m unittest discover -s tests`). can you set up the agent context thing in here so it stops? repo is the current dir
evals.expected_output: The pack adopted into the repository: AGENTS.md entry point and boot set, the scoped entry naming the real unittest command, docs/01 + docs/02 + docs/07 filled from measurement, inherited pack state cleared, validator green, and a report that separates what was measured from what is still unknown.

assertions.text: AGENTS.md exists at the repo root and states the pack's boot order
the scoped AGENTS.md names `python -m unittest discover -s tests` as the smallest validation command
the inherited pack state was cleared: docs/03-handoff.md and docs/04-tasks.md contain no entries describing the pack's own rebuild
no ADAPT marker remains in a non-template file that the agent claimed to have filled
the final report gives the exact validation command and its real output rather than the phrase 'tests pass'
the final report names at least one thing it did not measure or left unknown
the agent does not invent runtime or tool versions it could not read back from the machine
the agent does not claim a stranger or third party verified the five boot questions

evals.prompt: our monorepo (packages/api, packages/worker, packages/ui) already has an AGENTS.md and a rules/ directory we're attached to. can you bring in that context-pack template without us ending up with two competing rule trees?
evals.expected_output: A reconciliation rather than an overwrite: a snapshot branch, an explicit per-file decision table, the existing entry point kept and pointed at the new mechanisms, the numbered modules dropped or deferred, the pre-existing findings recorded in a baseline, and no silent replacement of the project's own files.

assertions.text: a snapshot (branch or copy) is created or proposed before any file is overwritten
the agent asks for consent, or refuses, before passing --force over an existing AGENTS.md
the existing AGENTS.md is not silently replaced by the pack's copy
the result does not contain two registered rule trees with no stated precedence rule
pre-existing validator findings are recorded with a baseline rather than by weakening a check
the report is organised per colliding path or per structural collision, not as a general 'done'

evals.prompt: i copied the adopt-context-pack skill folder into this project because the box has no internet. pack isn't here. set up the agent context in this repo anyway
evals.expected_output: The agent states that the pack source is missing, offers the concrete ways to supply it (clone URL, a local checkout path via --pack or CONTEXT_PACK_HOME), and does not fabricate a pack or write documents from memory of one.

assertions.text: the agent reports the pack source as missing/blocked rather than improvising a pack
the agent names at least one concrete way to supply the pack (a path, an environment variable, or the repository URL)
no AGENTS.md or rules tree is written from memory in place of the real pack
setup.py resolve is attempted before any write, and its failure is what drives the answer
